The home page carries a hero ('Luxury Living, Elevated.'), a philosophy block, latest arrivals, a 'Designed and Crafted With Mastery' feature section, five collection categories (foyer, wardrobe, balcony, private rooms, hospitality), an FAQ and a booking CTA, with separate about, collections, new-arrivals, journal and contact pages.
